D: Two musicians on the run from the mob disguise themselves as women in an all-girl band.
P: Serve the drinks when the girls throw a party in Daphne's sleeper berth on the train.
S: the 1929 Chicago speakeasy hidden in a funeral parlour
Salted peanuts roasted with butter and paprika, and a bowl of pickled onions, served on the bar.
the Seminole Ritz hotel on the Florida coast
Prawns poached in salted water with lemon, chilled and served on ice with cocktail sauce.
the party in Daphne's upper berth
Crackers topped with cheddar, salami and a sliver of pickle, stacked on a tray to pass up the ladder.
M: Lobster tails split and grilled with garlic butter for 6 minutes, with buttered baby potatoes, green beans and lemon.
the gangsters' banquet at the Florida hotel
Beef meatballs browned and simmered 40 minutes in tomato and basil sauce, piled over spaghetti on one big platter.
W: the giant birthday cake at the gangsters' banquet
Vanilla sponge baked in three tins at 175C for 25 minutes, stacked with jam and cream, iced white and topped with candles.
K: the girls mixing Manhattans in a hot water bottle
Bourbon stirred with sweet vermouth and bitters over ice, strained with a cherry. Use a jug, not a hot water bottle.

s.note: the 1929 Chicago speakeasy hidden in a funeral parlour
s.how: Melt 30g butter and toss through 300g peanuts with smoked paprika and sea salt. Roast at 180C for 10 minutes. Serve warm in a bowl beside a dish of pickled onions on the bar, before the band strikes up.

s.note: the Seminole Ritz hotel on the Florida coast
s.how: Bring a pot of salted water to the boil with lemon slices. Add 500g green prawns and poach for 2 minutes, then plunge into iced water. Peel and serve on ice with mayonnaise mixed with tomato sauce, lemon and hot sauce.

m.how: Split 4 lobster tails and brush with butter mixed with crushed garlic. Grill for 6 minutes until just cooked. Boil 800g baby potatoes and steam green beans, then toss both with butter. Serve with lemon wedges. Well, nobody's perfect.

w.note: the giant birthday cake at the gangsters' banquet
w.how: Beat 300g butter with 300g sugar, add 5 eggs and fold in 300g self-raising flour. Bake in 3 tins at 175C for 25 minutes. Stack with strawberry jam and whipped cream, ice white and top with candles. Watch who jumps out.

d.note: the girls mixing Manhattans in a hot water bottle
d.how: For each drink, stir 60ml bourbon, 30ml sweet vermouth and 2 dashes aromatic bitters with ice in a jug. Strain into chilled glasses and drop in a maraschino cherry. Use a jug, not a hot water bottle in an upper berth.
